rationale: Chris and Mina both work at the intersection of robotics and software systems—Chris as CTO at Zhavia Labs building robotics simulation tools, and Mina as a Robotic Engineer at Apple focused on robotics-manipulation and autonomous systems. Their complementary expertise (Chris's full-stack simulation and systems work in TypeScript/Python/Rust paired with Mina's hands-on robotics and ML background) could surface useful perspectives on bridging simulation to real-world robotic hardware challenges.
intro_message: Chris Orlin Cardoza, meet Mina Fanaian — you're both deep in robotics but from different angles (simulation infrastructure vs. hardware/autonomy), and could swap useful war stories.
